text: Phase 0 is implemented and verified. Added the exact baseline/ADR record, a content-addressed receipt validator, a 13-route JVM/Scala.js reconstruction corpus, shared Cats Effect release/cancel evidence, and a typed decode-program spike. D2 explicitly chooses an owned row-major Double ResponseBlock and no tensor framework. Verification passed: sbt compileAll; sbt -Djava.awt.headless=true testAll; receipt --check --live-sources --verify-corpus; git diff --check. Raw-bit routes are cross-platform identical; the two temporal-DCT routes satisfy the declared abs/rel 1e-12 comparator.
